name: ayaka tomonaga
source:
likes: rice (especially rice candy), horror movies, petting zoos, american cartoons
dislikes: spicy food, bugs, scratch n sniff markers, motorcycles

-ayaka almost always had some rice candies in her school bag.
-ayaka had to use a wheelchair when she was alive. as a ghost, she can't
float freely like the others can as she still doesn't have function of her
lower body. if she wants to move around as a ghost, she either needs to find
something she can sit on that can be moved, or needs to be carried.
-ayaka loves to play piano and her dream was to perform a piano recital at 
a large theatre hall. although she died before she could do so, she's even happier
with the fact that she and momoko can now play together for as long as they want.
